bio.text: Lisa Campbell was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in November 2022 and represents House District 35, covering Kennesaw and Acworth.
Before serving in the legislature, Campbell had 30 years of experience as an organizational consultant and is the founding partner of BRANDfit Consulting.
Campbell was born in El Paso, Texas, graduated from the University of Georgia in 1990 with a B.A. in English, and lives in Kennesaw.
